experiment_data.hypothesis: Binoculars (Hans et al., ICML 2024) cross-perplexity scores (observer=pythia-1.4b, performer=pythia-410m), when calibrated to 4-class ordinal depth, achieve near-chance accuracy on 9-cell atlas. Binoculars is binary detection SOTA; testing it is critical for completeness. Reviewer will ask "did you test Binoculars?"
